column1: # The catalog's hand rows, one console row each in the catalog's order, tab-separated: the row's name; its systems, each id=shelf and comma-separated, the first the row's console; the words a player types for the row, comma-separated; the engine that is the row's console's sole engine; and the console as a refusal names it when that engine is missing. The rows and shelf names are those the C# CoreCatalog had, which players' libraries hold; a console discovery adds needs no line (EmuSen_Backend.md §29.2).
